values.note: Forest Service, 2026-09-10: the campground 'has reopened and will remain open until the end of shrimp baiting season in November'. The whole recreation area will then close for a major renovation (anticipated to start fall 2026); the construction timeline will be posted once the contract is awarded.

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/buck-hall-recreation-area ('Update 9/10/26: Buck Hall Campground ... has reopened and will remain open until the end of shrimp baiting season in November'; 'During construction, which is anticipated to start in fall of 2026, the entire recreation area will be closed'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234128 ('Electricity and water hookups are available') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234128 (14 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, Electricity Hookup 50), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 back-in RV/trailer sites with electric (40 ft) plus 5 tent-only sites; grassy and open, little shade. Each site has a table, lantern post and fire ring with grill.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234128 (14 STANDARD ELECTRIC, Max Vehicle Length 40, Driveway Entry Back-In; 5 TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234128 ('grassy and open, with very few trees and limited shade'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234128 ('Accessible flush toilets, showers and drinking water are provided'; amenity Dump Station) + FS page ('dump station available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RV and tent sites are reservation only, on recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777, with a reservation fee added. recreation.gov opens bookings one month ahead and closes them 2 days before arrival. 14 days in any 30. Contact: Francis Marion Ranger District.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/buck-hall-recreation-area ('RV and tent campsites at Buck Hall are available by reservation only'; 'A reservation fee will be added'; 'Stay is limited to 14 days') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234128 (rules: reservationWindow 1 Months, reservationCutOff 2, maxConsecutiveStay 14), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $28 a night for an RV site with electric; tent sites $20. Day use $7 per vehicle for non-campers.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/buck-hall-recreation-area ('Single Site with electric hook-up: $28 per night'; 'Tent camping: $20 per day') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234128/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD ELECTRIC 28, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 20), read 2026-10-21

note: Campground has waterfront tent sites, but RV sites are set back a ways from the water. --AWH
summary: Confirmed $28 (2026) and 50-amp electric; added water hookups, 14 back-in RV sites to 40 ft, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, reservation-only on recreation.gov (1-month window, 2-day cutoff, 14-night limit) and status open with the FS 2026-09-10 update (open through November shrimp-baiting season, then closing for renovation). Dropped the rating line and the outdated 'Summer 2026' renovation sentence from the note. Not stated: campground season (the FS 'All year' is for the recreation area), senior-pass acceptance.
flags: Closure ahead: the Forest Service says the campground stays open only 'until the end of shrimp baiting season in November' 2026, after which the entire recreation area closes for a major renovation (contract not yet awarded, no timeline). Recorded as open with that note; it will need status temporarily_closed once the closure starts.
Entry has no phone. The Forest Service and recreation.gov give 843-336-2200 (Francis Marion Ranger District).
